hr.headline: Close a 2 FTE capacity gap
hr.recommendation: Review the anonymous skills worksheet, calibrate work samples and assign training or temporary staffing. The worksheet does not make hiring decisions.
evidence: Review score = 60% required-skill coverage + 40% work-sample score; only allowlisted candidate fields are accepted.
assumptions: All source inputs are fictional workshop data.
Staffing cost is a one-time workshop planning allowance per additional FTE, not a salary estimate.
risks: Skills and sample scores may still contain bias; protected-attribute exclusion does not establish fairness.
No demographic parity claim can be made from this anonymous dataset.

actions.task: Calibrate the rubric with a human reviewer and check accessibility
actions.gate: No candidate rejection or offer from this score

operations.headline: Production fits the launch window
operations.recommendation: Stage an initial release of at most 30,000 units. Reserve production capacity and validate supplier readiness before commitments.
assumptions: All source inputs are fictional workshop data.
The lead-time and production phases are sequential; lead time includes delivery to production.
risks: Daily capacity is assumed constant; downtime, transit and quality failures are not modelled.

actions.task: Confirm supplier milestone and alternate capacity

operations.narrative:
[Rehearsal · computed evidence]
Production fits the launch window

Stage an initial release of at most 30,000 units. Reserve production capacity and validate supplier readiness before commitments.

Completion = 21 lead days + ceil(30000/600) = 71 days.
Capacity = max(0, 84-21) × 600 = 37800 units.

finance.headline: INR 600,000 funding gap
finance.recommendation: Phase production or reallocate approved spend before launch; the full plan exceeds the current financial gates.
evidence: Cash required = 30,000 × INR 65 + INR 250,000 fixed + INR 180,000 marketing + INR 20,000 staffing = INR 2,400,000.
Revenue is constrained to 30000 deliverable units by Operations.
assumptions: All source inputs are fictional workshop data.
All units are financed upfront, unsold inventory retains its cost, and sold units collect cash immediately.
Scenario contribution less fixed costs is not accounting net profit.
risks: Taxes, financing, returns and payment collection delays are excluded.
Budget is insufficient for full upfront production.

actions.task: Approve a cash plan and test downside sell-through
actions.gate: No spend approval until the funding and margin gates pass
